title: The AI Voice Clone Scam Targeting Grandparents
description: AI voice-cloning tools can now recreate a family member's voice from a few seconds of audio. The FBI's 2025 Internet Crime Report tracked AI-enabled fraud as its own category for the first time — $893 million in losses, 40% of it hitting people over 60. Here's the one thing that defeats the scam.
sourceCitation: Source: FBI 2025 Internet Crime Report (IC3), released April 2026. Educational content only — not legal or financial advice. AI-generated narration. Stock footage via Pexels.

scenes.captionText: Your grandchild's voice can be cloned in 3 seconds.
scenes.narrationText: Your grandchild's voice can be cloned in three seconds. Here's how the scam actually works.

The FBI's 2025 Internet Crime Report tracked AI-enabled fraud as its own category for the first time — nearly nine hundred million dollars in losses in a single year, and forty percent of that hit people over sixty.

scenes.captionText: Built from a few seconds of audio.
scenes.narrationText: The scam call is built from just a few seconds of audio, often pulled from a social media video, run through free voice-cloning tools.
The one thing that defeats it: a family verification phrase the caller can't know. Something you agree on ahead of time, not something posted on social media.

scenes.narrationText: Set up your family's phrase today, before you need it.
